# project-nihon

Open-source sandbox MMORPG where players build a civilization. The world is persistent, expands over time, and evolves through player interaction. This fabric encodes the game's design bible — materials, skills, items, creatures, and world systems — as a single source of truth.

## Biome

- [TemperateForest](entities/temperateforest.md) — Broad mixed-leaf forests covering most mid-latitude landmass
- [TemperateGrassland](entities/temperategrassland.md) — Open rolling plains ideal for large settlements, agriculture, and mounted travel
- [TwilightGrove](entities/twilightgrove.md) — Eerie glades where day-night cycles run at an accelerated, unpredictable rate, bathing the land in perpetual half-light
- [VoidRift](entities/voidrift.md) — Fractured terrain surrounding permanent rifts in the fabric of reality
- [VolcanicBadlands](entities/volcanicbadlands.md) — Barren, heat-scorched terrain surrounding active or dormant volcanic calderas

## Creature

- [CinderGargoyle](entities/cindergargoyle.md) — A winged, stone-skinned predator that nests in volcanic caldera walls
- [ForestBoar](entities/forestboar.md) — A stout, bristle-furred boar that roots through the forest floor for tubers and fungi
- [GlimmerFox](entities/glimmerfox.md) — A sleek, luminescent fox native to the Twilight Grove whose fur shifts in hue with the accelerated day-night cycle
- [GraywolfPack](entities/graywolfpack.md) — A coordinated hunting pack of gray wolves that roam temperate forest edges and clearings
- [LavaSlug](entities/lavaslug.md) — A slow-moving, magma-encrusted slug the size of a cart horse that grazes on ashite mineral deposits
- [RidgeHawk](entities/ridgehawk.md) — A keen-eyed raptor that nests on grassland ridges and hunts small game from altitude
- [RiftWarden](entities/riftwarden.md) — An ancient construct of crystallised voidite that guards the innermost rift boundary
- [SteppeBison](entities/steppebison.md) — A massive, shaggy bison that grazes temperate grasslands in loose herds
- [VeilStalker](entities/veilstalker.md) — A lithe, shadowy predator that phases in and out of visibility in sync with the Twilight Grove's erratic light cycle
- [VoidSerpent](entities/voidserpent.md) — A massive serpentine entity born from void-rift energy given form

## Decision

- [DestructibleBuildings](entities/destructiblebuildings.md) — Buildings are destructible through game systems (fire, siege, structural failure) — not by arbitrary designer flags
- [FictionalMaterials](entities/fictionalmaterials.md) — Fictional materials with unique properties replace real-world counterparts, giving the world consistent internal lore and design freedom
- [GodotEngine](entities/godotengine.md) — Use Godot 4.x as the game client engine
- [KnowledgeByExperimentation](entities/knowledgebyexperimentation.md) — Knowledge is discovered through experimentation — recipes, materials, and world secrets are not handed to players via tooltips or vendors
- [MagicBalancedWithMartial](entities/magicbalancedwithmartial.md) — Magic and martial combat are balanced — no archetype dominates; each has unique trade-offs and counters
- [NoTeleportation](entities/noteleportation.md) — No teleportation; infrastructure replaces fast travel
- [OfflinePlayerNpcs](entities/offlineplayernpcs.md) — Offline players may be represented in the world as configurable service NPCs, keeping shops and services running in their absence
- [OnePersistentWorld](entities/onepersistentworld.md) — A single persistent official world server

## Material

- [Aethermite](entities/aethermite.md) — Pale silver ore that hums faintly in the presence of active magic
- [Ashite](entities/ashite.md) — Pale grey volcanic rock formed from compressed volcanic ash
- [Duskfiber](entities/duskfiber.md) — Fibrous bark harvested from the Duskwood trees that grow only in twilight biomes where day and night cycle at unusual speeds
- [Ferrite](entities/ferrite.md) — Common dark-grey metal found in surface veins across temperate biomes, volcanic lava-tube edges, and stabilised sections of void rifts
- [Lumenfite](entities/lumenfite.md) — Translucent crystalline mineral that absorbs ambient light during the day and releases it slowly at night
- [Thornwood](entities/thornwood.md) — Dense, dark-veined wood from the Thornwood tree that grows in lowland forests
- [Veilsteel](entities/veilsteel.md) — Blue-black alloy smelted from ferrite ingots and aethermite shards under high heat
- [Voidite](entities/voidite.md) — Jet-black crystalline ore found only in void-touched biomes and deep rifts

## Profession

- [Alchemist](entities/alchemist.md) — A reagent crafter who supplements alchemy knowledge with arcane forging to produce the most potent catalysts and consumables
- [Arcanist](entities/arcanist.md) — A practitioner who has married elemental control with enchanting craft, producing the most potent magical items and wielding area-control spells in combat
- [Blacksmith](entities/blacksmith.md) — Dedicated metalworker who has combined standard smithing with arcane forging techniques
- [Merchant](entities/merchant.md) — A commercial specialist who leverages trade acumen, diplomatic connections, and speechcraft to dominate NPC and player-to-NPC markets
- [Pathfinder](entities/pathfinder.md) — An expert scout and guide who can navigate any terrain invisibly, chart it accurately, and lead groups at full speed
- [Ranger](entities/ranger.md) — A wilderness specialist who combines ranged combat with reading the environment
- [VoidTouched](entities/voidtouched.md) — A rare hybrid who has survived void exposure and mastered both its magic and its smithing
- [Warrior](entities/warrior.md) — A frontline combatant who has mastered both offensive bladework and defensive shieldcraft

## Skill

- [Alchemy](entities/alchemy.md) — Brewing potions, reagents, poisons, and catalysts from raw materials
- [ArcaneForging](entities/arcaneforging.md) — Specialized metalworking at arcane forges that processes magical materials — primarily Aethermite — which shatter in standard forges
- [Archery](entities/archery.md) — Proficiency with bows and crossbows, covering aim stability, draw timing, and trajectory reading
- [Carpentry](entities/carpentry.md) — Working with Thornwood, Duskfiber, and other woody materials to craft furniture, structural building components, hafts, bows, and vehicles
- [Cartography](entities/cartography.md) — Charting unexplored territories and producing maps that can be sold or shared with other players
- [Diplomacy](entities/diplomacy.md) — Negotiating with NPC factions, guilds, and governing bodies to obtain favourable terms, treaties, or permissions
- [ElementalMagic](entities/elementalmagic.md) — Manipulation of the four classical elements — fire, earth, air, and water
- [Enchanting](entities/enchanting.md) — Imbuing refined items and materials with persistent magical effects using aethermite catalysts
- [Leadership](entities/leadership.md) — Inspiring and coordinating allies in combat and in civic roles
- [Navigation](entities/navigation.md) — Wayfinding without landmarks using stars, moss growth, wind direction, and terrain features
- [RestorationMagic](entities/restorationmagic.md) — Healing, shielding, and cleansing magic
- [Shieldcraft](entities/shieldcraft.md) — Techniques for using a shield offensively and defensively — blocking, parrying, bashing, and forming protective stances
- [Smithing](entities/smithing.md) — Metalworking at a forge — shaping ingots into weapons, armor, and structural components
- [Speechcraft](entities/speechcraft.md) — Persuasion, intimidation, and deception aimed at NPC targets
- [Stealth](entities/stealth.md) — Moving, hiding, and acting without detection
- [Swordsmanship](entities/swordsmanship.md) — Mastery of bladed weapons — from crude ferrite daggers to enchanted veilsteel longswords
- [Tracking](entities/tracking.md) — Reading environmental signs — footprints, disturbed foliage, scent trails — to follow creatures or players across terrain
- [Trade](entities/trade.md) — Commercial acumen that improves buy/sell spreads with NPC vendors and enables merchant-tier operations like bulk deals, consignment, and market stalls
- [Unarmed](entities/unarmed.md) — Hand-to-hand fighting techniques including strikes, grapples, and throws
- [VoidMagic](entities/voidmagic.md) — Channelling of void energy — entropic, corrupting, and capable of bypassing conventional magical resistance
- [VoidSmithing](entities/voidsmithing.md) — Esoteric art of working with void-touched materials, primarily Voidite, inside a specially shielded forge room

## System

- [BelievableNotRealistic](entities/believablenotrealistic.md) — Believable, not realistic — the world has internal consistency and lore logic rather than real-world physics fidelity
- [CivilizationIsPlayerMade](entities/civilizationisplayermade.md) — Civilization is player-made — towns, governments, economies, and infrastructure are built and maintained by players
- [CommunityOwnsTheFuture](entities/communityownsthefuture.md) — Community owns the future — the game is open-source and its direction is shaped by contributor consensus
- [EverythingHasTradeoffs](entities/everythinghastradeoffs.md) — Everything has trade-offs — no dominant strategy; every choice sacrifices something
- [FreedomComesFirst](entities/freedomcomesfirst.md) — Freedom comes first — players choose who to be, what to build, and how to play without imposed class or story restrictions
- [KnowledgeIsProgression](entities/knowledgeisprogression.md) — Knowledge is progression — players advance by discovering how the world works, not by grinding XP bars
- [MonetizationRules](entities/monetizationrules.md) — Monetization policy for Project Nihon: fair, transparent, and never pay-to-win
- [NoPayToWin](entities/nopaytowin.md) — No pay-to-win — monetary transactions never grant gameplay advantages over non-paying players
- [PlayersAreTheContent](entities/playersarethecontent.md) — Players are the content — there are no scripted quests; the world is shaped entirely by player action, economy, and politics
- [SystemsOverScripts](entities/systemsoverscripts.md) — Systems over scripts — dynamic simulation rules produce emergent outcomes rather than authored event sequences
- [TheWorldIsPersistent](entities/theworldispersistent.md) — The world is persistent — changes made by players endure; nothing resets without deliberate world-event mechanics
